app.name: LineHai?
app.description: Virtual queue system for government offices, hospitals, and public service centers

landing.hero_subtitle: No more standing in lines. Book your turn at government offices and service centers with LineHai? and save time.
landing.step1_desc: Scan the office QR code with your phone or visit the website and get your token.
landing.step2_desc: We will SMS you when your turn is near. You can stay at home until then.
landing.step3_desc: When your turn comes, arrive at the office and get served directly. No lines.
landing.testimonial1: Great system. No more crowds at our office. People only come when it's their turn.
landing.testimonial2: Earlier 200-300 people would stand in line daily. Now everyone takes online tokens and comes on time.
landing.testimonial3: The priority token facility for elderly and pregnant women is very useful.
landing.feature1: Free & Simple — No app download needed
landing.feature2: SMS Alerts — Get notified when your turn is near
landing.feature3: Priority Tokens — For elderly and emergencies
